slides.title: AUTHORITY TO PROCEED
slides.text: NASA Directorate convenes at the Artemis Arena: 'MAVEN 1 failed to survive the harsh Martian frontier. Today, we grant Authority to Proceed into Phase A for MAVEN 2: Establish a protected, sustainable human settlement on Mars!'

slides.title: COMMAND & SPECIALISTS
slides.text: Mission Commander Dr. Rodaina steps into the spotlight with Robotics Specialist Nour: 'We don't walk away from the greatest engineering challenge in human history. Let's get to work.'

slides.title: THE MARS SANDBOX
slides.text: Inside the Simulated EVA Yard, your first assignment begins: design and configure an autonomous rover capable of enduring steep terrain, radiation, dust storms, and retrieving vital geological samples.
